publisher: Island County GIS (Island County Zoning, unincorporated county)
filter: Zone IS NOT NULL AND Zone NOT LIKE 'Oak Harbor%' AND Zone <> 'Municipality/NMUGA'
notes: Island County unincorporated zoning (ICC 17.03) with Island County GIS. Covers county land only; city land appears as Municipality/NMUGA placeholders and Oak Harbor zones (already saved), excluded by filter. Includes UGA-Langley and NMUGA county zones. Zone_Abbr can be null for some overlays; CodeLink is a code reference field, may be a link or text.
